methodology_note: WebFetch access to etsy.com, amazon.com, pinterest.com, trends.google.com, tiktok.com and most third-party analytics blogs was blocked by the session's network egress policy. Findings are based on WebSearch snippets/summaries and publicly reported facts only. No sales figures, review counts, or search-volume numbers were invented; unverifiable claims are flagged in research/raw/*/2026-08-27-*-sticker-research.md. This is the sticker module's first-ever run (baseline); momentum_score is null for every theme. On the same day (2026-08-27), the top 3 themes were deep-dived into 28 sub-niches total per an explicit user request; several scores/decisions were revised in place (see per-theme 'notes') rather than duplicated as new dated rows, since this is a same-day refinement, not a new week's observation.

ranking.why: 3市場(Etsy/Pinterest/SNS)確認済み、サブニッチ深掘りでConfidenceがHighに強化された唯一のテーマ。Sticker Fit・Coloring Fit双方が高く、既存の塗り絵テーマ`cottagecore-mushroom-garden`と直結するためBOTH展開・シリーズ展開性が最も高い。
唯一の一次事実データ(book club stickers +243%)を持つが、Coloring Fitが低くステッカー単体商品。商品化スピードは速いが横展開性はGoblincoreに劣る。
サブニッチ深掘りの結果、基準ニッチ(Pastel Bow)は専門書籍まで出るほど成熟済みと判明。BUILD_NOWからTESTへ格下げ。Ballet Bow等の細分化ニッチのみ限定的な価値あり。
